note: Ratchet baseline for the in-progress board. CI fails the DRC step only if a count RISES above these numbers (regression, or the checker changed behaviour) or if the DRC tool/report itself is broken. Counts at or below the baseline are reported as board state, never as 'DRC passed'. When routing completes (0 violations, 0 unconnected), set both counts to 0: the same step then acts as a hard zero-tolerance DRC gate again, with no code change. CALIBRATION (round 2, 2026-11-03): these numbers are the FIRST TRUE MEASUREMENT of the current board, superseding the round-1 seed (807/175). The seed's recorded provenance was a KiCad 8 run on main @ b5c2b57 — but git shows that tree carried the PRE-v5 board (blob ebe97655), so the seed measured the previous board, not this one. The current board changed exactly once between b5c2b57 and ec773ed: fb2acf7 (router v5 result) replaced hw/pdlvds_rx.kicad_pcb (blob ebe97655 -> 6a377ebc), reaching main via the routing-work merges; both parents of ec773ed carry blob 6a377ebc. The delta direction matches v5's documented trade (stricter clearance model: fewer violations; fewer nets routed, 58/112 vs v4's 67/112: more unconnected). This is calibration to a first measurement of a changed board — not ratchet-loosening to fit a regression: no count was raised above a same-board measurement, because no same-board measurement existed before run 41750532660. JITTER TOLERANCE (round 3, 2026-11-03): KiCad 8's DRC is not perfectly deterministic on an unchanged board. Run 41751841325, on the IDENTICAL board blob (6a377ebc — the ci-signal rounds touched no board files), measured 727 violations / 190 unconnected where run 41750532660 measured 726 / 190: ±1 run-to-run jitter on violations, unconnected stable at 190 in both runs. The round-2 ratchet (any rise = regression) fired REGRESSION on the second run — a false alarm from checker jitter, not routing. tolerance_violations: 5 and tolerance_unconnected: 2 absorb that jitter: sized from the single observed ±1 sample with headroom, yet far below any real routing regression, which moves counts by tens (the v3->v4->v5 re-routes moved violations by 100+). The baseline itself STAYS 726/190, the reference measurement from run 41750532660; the tolerance is the jitter mechanism, the baseline is NOT raised to 727. Standing rule: upward drift beyond the tolerance is real signal — investigate it, never silently re-baseline to absorb it. When the baseline is 0/0 (finished board) the gate ignores tolerances entirely: the hard zero-tolerance end state is unchanged.
source_run: GitHub Actions CI run 41750532660 on branch main at commit ec773ed (KiCad 8 native `kicad-cli pcb drc --severity-all`); console output and the report file agree (726 violations, 190 unconnected pads). Report preserved as ci/fixtures/drc-report-run41750532660.txt
